url_citation.title: Food Tube: How video storytelling led to 2m YouTube subscribers – Search Engine Watch
url_citation.content:
# Food Tube: How video storytelling led to 2m YouTube subscribers

...

Food Tube is part of the Jamie Oliver Media Group and it was launched in 2013, as a new way to present food recipes, both in an informative and entertaining angle, hoping to transform the traditional format that we’ve known from Jamie Oliver since then.

...

Thus, Food Tube became the food channel that combined recipes, tutorials, funny videos and guest collaborations, leading to 2.3 million followers and 210.577.027 views (as of May 10th)

...

The art of storytelling can be powerful on social media and Food Tube quickly realised how a story can transform any type of content. Thus, it started treating each recipe like a story, creating a unique perspective, adding the needed authenticity, but also the personal element that will make the content relevant to the audience.

...

## Mixing content

...

There is no strategy that fits every channel and that’s why Food Tube keeps experimenting with several topics for its videos, while it also keeps several established categories as the most frequent ones (1 minute tips, 15 minute meals, Jamie’s super food, etc).

What’s more, Food Tube focuses on the most popular holidays and celebrations to provide relevant content, from Easter and Halloween, to Father’s Day, or Pancake Day.

...

url_citation.content:
With 6 million subscribers, Jamie Oliver is a popular channel on YouTube. The Jamie Oliver YouTube channel started in 2006 and is based in United Kingdom.

...

YouTube and Online Presence: Jamie Oliver has a strong online presence. His YouTube channels, including Food Tube, attract millions of subscribers. He shares recipes and cooking tips, generating ad revenue and sponsorships. This digital platform allows him to connect with a global audience.

...

Jamie Trevor Oliver was born on May 27, 1975, in Clavering, Essex, England. He grew up in a family deeply rooted in the restaurant business. His parents, Trevor and Sally Oliver, owned a pub called the Cricketers. This environment sparked Jamie's passion for cooking at a young age. He spent countless hours in the kitchen, learning the ropes alongside his family.

...

In 2013, Oliver embraced the digital age by launching his YouTube channel, Food Tube. This move allowed him to connect with a younger audience and share his passion for cooking in a more interactive format. His YouTube presence has grown significantly, with over 2 million subscribers across multiple channels. This expansion into online content has helped him maintain relevance in an ever-changing media landscape.

...

### What is Jamie Oliver's YouTube channel?

...

Jamie Oliver launched his YouTube cooking channel, Food Tube, in 2013. He has since grown his presence on the platform, amassing over 2 million subscribers across three channels, where he shares recipes, cooking tips, and culinary inspiration.

...

### What types of content can viewers expect from Jamie Oliver's YouTube channels?

...

Viewers can expect a variety of content, including cooking tutorials, recipe demonstrations, collaborations with other chefs, and tips for healthy eating. His channels often feature engaging and interactive content that encourages audience participation.
